**CLAIM** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4474-org-i18n`.

**Ruling (delegated authority; open veto window)**: unlocked by PR #4480 landing (shared surface). Three string families, three treatments — kept as ONE card since it is one sweep over one feature:

1. **Client-authored strings** (role names in the invite dropdown, role badges, dialog labels): route through the existing i18n channel per repo convention (defaults-maps + packs; the #4409 map-mirror gate is live — every new key needs its map rows). **One-answer requirement**: role display names come from ONE shared role-label map consumed by BOTH the dropdown and the badges — the card's measured inconsistency (`Owner`/`Member` badges beside 所有者/成员 dropdown) is exactly two hand-authored lists drifting; collapse them.
2. **Server-supplied strings** (the three echoed messages): map the stable better-auth `code` (e.g. `YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_INVITE_USERS_TO_THIS_ORGANIZATION`) → translated message, per the card's own analysis. Unknown code → show the raw server message as fallback (never swallow an error; prefer mapped, degrade to verbatim). Do NOT translate English text by string-matching.
3. **Icon-only `aria-label`s** (Member actions / Copy invitation link / Cancel invitation): same i18n channel — these are the only label a screen reader gets.

**Red-first**: zh-locale render tests on the six measured sites — pre-fix red showing the English strings, post-fix the zh resolutions; code-mapping unit tests (known code → zh, unknown code → verbatim fallback, both directions pinned). Must-not-change: en locale still renders correct English through the same channel.

**Grading**: patch `@object-ui/app-shell` (strings/i18n only; `.d.ts`-checked, never major).

**Surface (mutual exclusion)**: `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/**` (the five files the card names) + defaults-maps/packs per convention + tests + one changeset. Disjoint from in-flight #4431 (chatbot/core/fields/ledger), #4473 (RootLandingRedirect/app surface), #4452 (plugin-calendar), #4462 (print stylesheet + three button sites — it does NOT enter organizations/). #4475 (members-page role gating) is POOLED behind this card — do not fix the gating, strings only.
